# CASEs with `kind` `thought-experiment`

*Case kinds — What kind of thing a CASE is, beside how much of it is fact (standing). The two are orthogonal (ADR-042).*

**Thought experiment** — an imagined scenario, usually a contrast that holds everything fixed but one thing, used to test an intuition or a concept.
